name: Robot Controller Communication Latency
description: Fieldbus latency between robot controller and external PLC. Checks whether synchronised motion control is achievable.

elements.name: EtherCAT Cycle Jitter
elements.description: Timing jitter of the EtherCAT fieldbus cycle. Uncertain due to CPU load and interrupt latency.

uncertainty.source: Real-time OS latency measurements under load

elements.name: Maximum Allowable Jitter
elements.description: Maximum jitter for synchronised multi-axis motion per EtherCAT specification

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(jitter_bus) = jitter_bus if jitter_bus <= jitter_max, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The EtherCAT jitter limit guards the fieldbus latency uncertainty set; jitter values above 10 µs are excluded as incompatible with synchronised multi-axis motion.
